description_sq: Ofrohet per shitje nje apartament 3+1 i cili ndodhet ne fund te rruges 5 maji, i pozicionuar ne katin e 3 te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor. Organizohet ne nje korridor i cili ben shperndarjen e ambjenteve, nje soxhorno spacioze , 3 dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe nje ballkon i cili rrethor pothuajse te gjithe perimetrin e apartamenrit. Prona eshte ne proces hipotekimi. Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni
description_en: A 3+1 apartment is offered for sale, which is located at the end of 5 Maji street, located on the 3rd floor of a new building with an elevator. It is organized in a corridor that distributes the premises, a spacious living room, 3 bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony that surrounds almost the entire perimeter of the apartment. The property is in the mortgage process. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me
